_meta.title: Backroom cruising A+B retained-candidate QA, positions 11–15
_meta.status_scheme: Research assessment: site identity, source activity in 2025-11-08..2026-11-08, ordinary access, duplications, evidence gaps. 'Retain' is about this research list, not approval to publish.
_meta.limitations: Primary Gays-Cruising spot pages and city indexes plus official geography were examined where available; cross-source archive evidence earlier. No exhaustive login-protected search of all eight providers. Forum commenters' reports are anonymous, not independent confirmation. User controls all production edits.

records.name: Barbora
records.research_decision: Retain with recent meetup-proposal-only label; no verified cruising observation
records.place_and_location: Lake Barbora is a former surface mine reservoir near Oldřichov/Jeníkov, close to Teplice. Stored coordinates 50.643025,13.750784 broadly match independently recorded water-reservoir location (50.643079,13.750536). A named lake suffices under owner's general-area rule; source does not identify which shore.

dated_activity.finding: Poster advertises planned afternoon sexual gathering; not a report that it happened.

records.ordinary_access_and_facilities: Euroregion Elbe/Labe describes main swimming season June–September daily 08:00–19:00, beach resort full entry 80 CZK and reduced 40 CZK, and no-charge access outside summer; seasonal and admission claims are for public beach, not adult meeting. Official tourist sources say lake is used by bathers, divers and watersports; former mine lake very deep.
records.duplicate_and_identity: Original source labels larger Teplice region, official municipal locality Jeníkov; no independently established duplicate within this five-record group.
records.corrections_or_actions: Retain town correction Jeníkov; do not infer male cruisers or peak times from a single May 2026 advertisement. If showing fees, attribute beach operator prices to published tourism guide and note changeable.

records.name: Városliget
records.research_decision: Retain with clear recent discussion only; no verified encounter
records.place_and_location: Budapest City Park Városliget, location 47.51458,19.08353 is a plausible general park point. Primary original description claims tree area near House of Music Hungary and a children's playground, but the purported current subarea is not confirmed. Do not publish sexual access instructions near a playground.

dated_activity.finding: Latest Budapest country-index comment: 'I may be there early afternoon tomorrow'.

records.ordinary_access_and_facilities: Public city park with prominent cultural institutions and family attractions; neither the park's public access nor any venue's opening hours confirms cruising activity.
records.duplicate_and_identity: No evidence that adjacent House of Music and park are separate cruising listings; park claim remains a broad named location.
records.corrections_or_actions: Current copy identifies the park but does not establish a definite present meeting area or busy hours; no definitive map correction needed. Do not treat 2026 questions as 2026 eyewitness activity.

records.name: Corvin-negyed metro station
records.research_decision: Retain as recent directory meeting coordination, but verify that the source toilet and municipal underpass WC are same facility before enriching
records.place_and_location: Corvin-negyed is Budapest's M3 metro station, not the source misspelling 'Corbin'. Independent Budapest public-WC sources specifically identify a paid toilet at the Corvin-negyed/József körút underpass (Ferenc körút/Üllői út junction), which is a concrete facility clue. NOT proved this is the same exact toilet as the original cruising-directory claim. Stored 47.4856,19.0697 is general station-area point.

dated_activity.finding: 'Now?' and 'Yes' replies in original source; neither confirms an in-person visit.
Older activity claim falls outside 12-month review window.

records.ordinary_access_and_facilities: City WC listings (municipal list dated 2024) indicate underpass toilet 06:00–18:00, 250 HUF, no step-free access; as of November 2026 present operating hours and fee are NOT independently confirmed. Do not conflate newer guide's publication with a newly verified 2026 access record.
records.duplicate_and_identity: Corvin-negyed M3 metro vs nearby Corvin Plaza retail toilets are different settings; do not merge or repin without source match.
records.corrections_or_actions: New geographical clue: corroborate underpass WC against source photo/GPS. Correct source spelling in search alias only; published name already correct. Continue to label 2025 conversation as coordination only.

records.name: Népliget
records.research_decision: Retain as recent forum discussion only; historical first-person activity predates cutoff
records.place_and_location: Named large Budapest park Népliget near metro M3, existing coordinates 47.4753,19.09995 are a general park location. Original source describes a side parking area on Vajda Péter Street and surrounding paths; useful historical source-level subarea clue, not currently verified pin.

dated_activity.finding: Recent site-specific question, not observed sexual activity.
Poster claimed an encounter on the prior Thursday. Not evidence after 2025-11-08 cutoff.

records.ordinary_access_and_facilities: August 2026 reporting describes municipal plans to renew Népliget with improved paths and facilities. This is not evidence that the park or the claimed parking area is currently closed or under active construction.
records.duplicate_and_identity: No proven duplicate within reviewed group; don't confuse general park with adjacent metro/bus station.
records.corrections_or_actions: Add a qualified note in research describing the historic Vajda Péter Street reference, without presenting that parking as exact current meeting location. Retain broad park pin and recent discussion-only source classification.

records.name: Germanus Gyula Park
records.research_decision: Retain as self-reported presence only, not cruising encounter
records.place_and_location: Named park near Buda end of Margit Bridge, Budapest District II. Map reference 47.51564,19.03879 plausible general park locator. Exact alleged cruising subsection not identified.

dated_activity.finding: Budapest country index commenter writes in Hungarian 'I'm in the park'. No indication of an encounter or repeated activity.

records.ordinary_access_and_facilities: Public small park. A September 2026 municipal-public issue report identifies the park at Margit Bridge, supporting that the physical park exists; does not substantiate cruising.
records.duplicate_and_identity: Separate named green area from larger Budapest Városliget and Népliget; do not combine.
records.corrections_or_actions: No confirmed geographical correction. Retain only with explicit presence-versus-activity distinction and avoid inventing busyness/crowd.

material_findings: Corvin-negyed: independently named underpass WC at József körút; need confirm corresponds to original directory WC
Népliget: original historical description identifies Vajda Péter Street parking vicinity, which existing copy leaves out
Lake Barbora: official seasonal beach hours, public admissions, and precise Jeníkov geography independently corroborated
